Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Kavya - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sunita and Riya stand near him.]

Kunal: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Kunal (softly): "Really?"

[Kunal drinks a glass of water.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal writes in his notebook.]

Riya: "Exactly right."

[Kunal slams the door shut.]

Kunal: "Let's see."

[Kunal opens the window.]

Kunal: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Sunita: "Kunal, look over here."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Kunal (laughing): "Yes, of course."

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Kunal: "Let's see."

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Sunita (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Sunita: "Good job, Kunal!"

[The sun is blazing and Kunal is sweating.]

Kunal: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Kunal, look over here."

[Kunal whispers something to Mother.]

Kunal (gently): "That's great!"

[Kunal shouts angrily.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal takes the bag from Mother.]

Sunita (happily): "I knew it!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal opens his umbrella.]

Sunita: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Kunal puts on his raincoat.]

Kunal (gently): "What a day to remember!"
